title: Still-present carry-forward (r3 W2): pullback_yields test writes the developer's real ~/.pp-settings.bin on every odin test app run
evidence: app/pullback_test.odin:25 `app^ = {}` (zeroes settings_path_override); :286 `effect_settings_adjust(&app7, &app7.input, rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_PULLBACK, 0)`; app/main.odin:1037 `settings_save_app(app)` (unconditional tail of effect_settings_adjust); app/settings.odin:242-245 `p := app.settings_path_override; if p == "" { p = settings_path() }` -> settings_save_at(p, app.a11y) where settings_path() = $HOME/.pp-settings.bin. Only settings_test.odin:370 ever sets the override; pullback_test.odin never does.
detail: The app7 fixture leaves settings_path_override empty, so the test persist clobbers the developer's real HOME settings file with fixture state (palette Off, motion off, 100%, pullback OFF) on every local and CI test run.
recommended_fix: Set app.settings_path_override to a temp path in pullback_test_app (the adjust_test_app pattern), or make settings_save_app no-op a zeroed App in tests.
